campaign.name: Meshy SMB launch: today's site vs. the brief
campaign.product: Meshy is an AI 3D generation platform. It turns a sketch, photo or prompt into a textured, rigged, print-ready model in about a minute, sends it into Blender, Unity, Unreal or a slicer, and offers an API, a shared studio workspace and enterprise controls. The SMB push adds a free Meshy Certified program and an AI outreach agent, Myko.

variants.headline: The Only 3D AI Trained to Print

variants.rationale: Meshy's current site messaging, assembled from the meshy.ai homepage headlines and proof as read on Nov 9, 2026 (the messaging teardown). Not a single ad Meshy runs. It is here to show how far the brief's directions move each persona.

variants.rationale: Creative brief direction 1. For the art director, tech artist and solo dev. Leads with the hybrid pipeline and the strongest studio proof.

attacks.attack: One-click final assets is exactly the sentence that ends up in a layoff deck. I've seen the 500k-triangle crates. Call it final and my lead will expect me to ship it as is.

attacks.attack: Final assets that ship in a game need clean provenance and an indemnity behind them. If you claim production use, I need the terms that cover production use.
attacks.evidence_needed: Indemnity terms for shipped assets and the licensed-data statement in the contract.

attacks.attack: A production claim with no evidence goes straight into our vendor risk file.
attacks.evidence_needed: Published evidence for the claim, or drop it.

attacks.attack: If I repeat 'one-click final' to my team, I lose them. If I repeat it to my publisher, I own it.

stress.rewrite: Base meshes for props and background assets in minutes, ready for your team to finish in Blender or the engine. 37 Interactive cut high-poly work by 30 to 40%.
stress.rewrite_rationale: Drops 'production-ready' and 'one-click', which every critic attacked, scopes the promise to the hybrid pipeline with artists finishing the work, and uses the one cleanup-related proof point in the MRD.

transcript.text: Meshy gives your team base meshes in minutes, inside your existing pipeline, so you can spend your time on the work that matters.
The work that matters. So the props don't? Half my job is props. When a studio says AI will save time, I hear that they'll need fewer of us. And I'd want to know what your model was trained on.

Fair. Meshy is trained only on licensed data, and your studio can switch off training on anything you make. You decide what it touches. Most teams start with background props and keep hero assets by hand.

Licensed is a word every vendor uses. If I could see where the data came from, and my lead put in writing that we pick what goes to the tool, I'd try it on crates and barrels. Not on anything with my name on it.
That's how we'd run the pilot: your team picks the asset list, and there's a free certification so you're the one who knows the tool best.

The certification is interesting, actually. If the studio uses this anyway, I'd rather be the one who knows it. But the first 500k-triangle crate I have to retopologize, I'm out, and I'll be the one telling the team whether it's worth it.

brief.summary: Meshy is an AI 3D generation platform. It turns a sketch, photo or prompt into a textured, rigged, print-ready model in about a minute, sends it into Blender, Unity, Unreal or a slicer, and offers an API, a shared studio workspace and enterprise controls. The SMB push adds a free Meshy Certified program and an AI outreach agent, Myko.
brief.target: Net-new B2B customers across three segments: independent pros and startups (indie game developers, freelance 3D artists, AI developers, product-visual startups and print shops), SMB game studios of 10 to 200 people, and large studios, publishers and art outsourcers.
brief.proposition: Base meshes in minutes, finished in your tools, and every model stays yours.
brief.tone: Plain, specific and respectful of craft. Talk like a technical artist who has shipped games, not like an AI company. Confident, never hyped. No exclamation marks.
mandatories: Never imply replacing artists, cutting headcount or beating a human modeler.
Promise a hybrid pipeline, never one-click final assets.
Only use claims with proof in the MRD; the blind test, user counts and the 4.7 rating stay out.
Include at least one trust line in every direction: ownership, private by default, or opt out of training.
Never disparage Tripo, Rodin or Hunyuan3D by name.

competitors.name: Tripo AI
competitors.positioning: Fast AI 3D generation with production-ready quad topology, sold on scale (20M+ creators, 200M models).
competitors.source: Their own site copy, from the messaging teardown (Nov 9, 2026)

competitors.name: Hyper3D Rodin
competitors.positioning: The world's highest-quality, most controllable AI 3D model generator, for professionals.
competitors.source: Their own site copy, from the messaging teardown (Nov 9, 2026)

competitors.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D
competitors.positioning: Free, open-weights 3D generation from Tencent, used in Tencent's own game studios.
competitors.source: Their own site copy, from the messaging teardown (Nov 9, 2026)

competitors.name: Google Antigravity
competitors.positioning: An agent-first platform where Gemini agents build playable 3D games and scenes from a prompt.
competitors.source: Their own site copy, from the messaging teardown (Nov 9, 2026)

F1.ours: Turn a sketch, photo or prompt into a textured model in about a minute, then finish it in the tools you already use.
F1.tripo: Create 3D models in seconds from text and images.
F1.rodin: The world's highest-quality, most controllable AI 3D model generator.
F1.hunyuan: Free, high-accuracy generation: 3x the modeling accuracy of the previous version.

F2.ours: Auto-rig your character and pick from 600+ animations without leaving Meshy.
F2.hunyuan: Hunyuan 3D Studio covers UV mapping, rigging and skinning.

F3.ours: Watertight, slicer-ready models sent straight to Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer, print-ready on the first try up to 97% of the time.

F4.ours: Send models straight into Blender, Unity, Unreal, Godot, Maya or Roblox Studio. 37 Interactive cut high-poly work by 30 to 40%.
F4.tripo: Smart Mesh: native quads, 500 to 25K polys, ready for game production, no retopology.
F4.rodin: ControlNets for bounding box, voxel and point cloud, plus DCC plugins.

F5.ours: Give your agent a 3D skill. Generate and refine models from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or your own pipeline through the API and MCP.
F5.hunyuan: Tencent Cloud API with custom model training, and open weights you can self-host.
F5.antigravity: Agents write the geometry, script Blender over MCP and make textures, all inside one task.

F6.ours: Shared seats and credits for your team, private by default, with one admin switch to keep your work out of model training.
F6.tripo: A Team Program for studios, with ISO 27001.
F6.rodin: SSO, roles and a shared workspace for teams.

F7.ours: Trained only on licensed data. Never trained on yours, by contract. SSO, retention you set, and SOC 2 and ISO 27001 reports.
F7.rodin: Enterprise security and licensed training data.
